name: Ryan Cooper
profile: Target man. Performance varies a lot night to night and runs on confidence: praise raises it and raises his performance, criticism drops both sharply. Does well when he gets the ball, holds it and lays it off. Can score goals — curled one into the top corner from the byline on 27 August 2026, and played well above a 4 across that game. Moved to 4.5; Mat rates him a 5 or 6 on that showing, so he may well be worth another step.
